sharedRules.name: Combat Doctrines
sharedRules.description:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one Combat Doctrine listed below. If you do, that Combat Doctrine is active for friendly units with this ability until the start of your next Command Phase

Assault Doctrine
When this unit is selected to make an Advance move, that Advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

Devastator Doctrine
This unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]

Tactical Doctrine
When this unit is selected to make a Fall-back move, that Fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge.

Unless otherwise stated, you can only select each Combat Doctrine once per battle
Unless otherwise stated, only one Combat Doctrine can be active for each unit. If a rule make a Combat Doctrine active for a unit, any Combat Doctrine previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

sharedRules.name: Librarius
sharedRules.description:
Friendly psyker units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 of higher, specified in that unit's abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability's name.
In a battle round, a friendly psyker unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that psyker unit's psyker level
